answer_1.quote: The proposed 'task-independent text-generation control method' was comprehensively evaluated by applying it to summarization and story-generation tasks.
answer_1.outputs: generated summaries and stories with controlled keywords at specified positions

answer_2.quote: Whether the given keywords are placed at given positions was evaluated first in terms of (i) the accuracy of generating text including all target keywords and (ii) the accuracy of generating text in which all target keywords are placed in each target position.
